name: YAML
summary: Human-oriented data serialization language with indentation-based block structure, a JSON-compatible flow syntax, anchors/aliases for shared and cyclic nodes, and tags resolved through schemas. Ubiquitous as a configuration format.

level_notes.0: There is no single reference implementation. libyaml (C, YAML 1.1) underlies PyYAML, Psych and many bindings; yaml-reference-parser is generated mechanically from the 1.2 spec productions; yaml-test-suite is the shared conformance corpus that implementations are compared against (matrix.yaml.info).
level_notes.1: The YAML 1.2.2 specification (yaml.org) is normative; many deployed parsers still implement YAML 1.1 with its larger implicit-typing rules, so the 1.1 spec and the 1.1 type repository are linked as well. RFC 9512 registers the media type.
level_notes.2: Much secondary literature is implementation- or tool-specific (PyYAML, Ansible, Kubernetes/Helm); critical essays on implicit typing are included because they explain the 1.1/1.2 differences.
